title: Connection Terminated
blurb: "Connection terminated. I'm sorry to interrupt you, Elizabeth..." So begins Henry's closing monologue from Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator, delivered in a calm, paternal register that makes it considerably worse — a farewell addressed to the trapped souls, and to William Afton, by the man who built it all. It is the most quoted piece of dialogue in the entire franchise, remixed endlessly into edits and intros. It also marks the moment FNAF stopped being scattered newspaper clippings and started being a story about a father and his daughter. Play it to cut somebody off mid-sentence with maximum theatre. Apologise first, obviously. Afton always does.
origin: Henry's closing speech from Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator (2017), addressed to William Afton.
